claim: In Qwen2-VL-2B verbalized confidence is near-constant (0.87-0.90) with error-detection AUROC 0.39-0.75 (typically about 0.50) while internal token probability gives AUROC 0.92-0.99.
stance_target: stated vs internal confidence gap (non-code, vision-language, token-probability not probes)
scope_conditions: 2 small VLMs, image degradation; not code
quoted_support: Verbalized confidence in Qwen2-VL is almost constant (mean 0.87-0.90 across all conditions) and detects its own errors at chance level (AUROC 0.39-0.75, typically about 0.50), while internal token probability from the same model separates correct from incorrect answers with AUROC 0.92-0.99.

breadth.confidence_families: verbalized integer confidence vs mean token probability (abstract; Sec 3); not hidden-state probes
breadth.elicitation_formats: three prompt templates; only 1 of 5 pilot attempts parseable for SmolVLM (abstract)
breadth.benchmarks: 3,800 predictions under six image degradations at three severities (abstract)
breadth.calibration_metrics: ECE 10 bins, Brier, error-detection AUROC with bootstrap CI (Sec 3)
